text: Add modular hybrid code intelligence for semantic maps and improvement discovery
description: Provide code search and mapping that combines exact search, symbols/references, syntax chunks, semantic embeddings, dependency structure, git churn, tests/coverage, and aim history. Expose focused tools such as code_search, symbol_context, change_impact, and high-leverage improvement discovery without loading every capability into every loop.
reflection: Relevance check on 2026-07-30 found the defined core capability shipped. The previous partial status retained only optional, benchmark-driven refinements without a concrete failing use case, so the finite delivered slice moved to review rather than inviting speculative expansion.

status.comment: The modular semantic/heuristic code-intelligence capability and aim-history retrieval are implemented and verified. LSP/AST and coverage signals remain optional future refinements; awaiting acceptance of the delivered capability.
